lines.text: Good morning sir, main aapke bank ke KYC department se bol rahi hoon.
Aapka KYC expire ho gaya hai, aaj raat tak update nahi kiya toh account block ho jayega.
Main abhi online update kar deti hoon, aapke phone par ek OTP aaya hoga, woh bataiye.
Jaldi karo sir, time nahi hai, system band ho jayega.
